name: Aoi Satou
source: Though she appears meek and withdrawn, Aoi possesses a fierce streak that few people ever see. She relies on Noriko a bit too much, yet she has no idea of Noriko's role in the murders plaguing Tokyo.
translation: Though she appears meek and withdrawn, Aoi possesses a fierce streak that few people ever see. She relies on Noriko a bit too much, yet she has no idea of Noriko's role in the murders plaguing Tokyo.
